celfmt -agent -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
interval: {{interval}}
run_as_cel: true
cel:
  state:
    api_token: {{api_token}}
{{#if first_interval}}
    lookback: {{first_interval}}
{{/if}}
  # The program.
  program: |
    state.with({"events":[],"want_more":false})
  redact:
    fields: ~
tags:
  - run_as_cel
